worldcombat.skill.megapunch.summary: The user coils, then drives one full-bodied straight punch down a narrow lane: what stands in the lane takes the heaviest single-target hit of the elemental punches and is shoved straight back. Step aside and it misses.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.use.0: Land a knockout straight punch inside the lane
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.use.1: Shove a target in front clean out of position
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.use.2: Hit a planted target with the heaviest single blow
Punches down a lane %2$s blocks long and %3$s blocks half-wide for %1$s contact and punch damage.
Anyone struck is shoved about %1$s blocks along the lane; standing outside the lane or stepping aside makes it miss.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.planted.on: Planted: a heavier punch (power x1.14) that shoves farther (x1.25), but a longer coil, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.planted.off: Mobile: quicker coil, recovery and cooldown, but a lighter punch that shoves less, better for sustained pressure.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; coil %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the shove to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.preference.p: On: a heavier punch (power x1.14) that shoves farther (x1.25), but +4 ticks coil, +3 recovery, +9 cooldown, for one decisive blow. Off (mobile): quicker coil, recovery and cooldown, but a lighter punch that shoves less, better for sustained pressure.
worldcombat.skill.megapunch.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The straight reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: low-health targets rank first, finishing them with this decisive blow; off: all targets score the same.
